verses.original: Ὃ ἦν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς ὃ ἀκηκόαμεν ὃ ἑωράκαμεν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν ὃ ἐθεασάμεθα καὶ αἱ χεῖρες ἡμῶν ἐψηλάφησαν περὶ τοῦ Λόγου τῆς ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: Ho ēn ap’ archēs ho akēkoamen ho heōrakamen tois ophthalmois hēmōn ho etheasametha kai hai cheires hēmōn epsēlaphēsan peri tou Logou tēs zōēs
verses.literal: That which was from the beginning which we have heard which we have seen with our own eyes which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands this is the Word of life
verses.literalPt: O que era desde o princípio, o que temos ouvido, o que temos visto com os nossos olhos, o que contemplamos e o que as nossas mãos apalparam, a respeito do Verbo da vida

verses.original: καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἐφανερώθη καὶ ἑωράκαμεν καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν καὶ ἀπαγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον ἥτις ἦν πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ἐφανερώθη ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai hē zōē ephanerōthē kai heōrakamen kai martyroumen kai apangellomen hymin tēn zōēn tēn aiōnion hētis ēn pros ton Patera kai ephanerōthē hēmin
verses.literal: And this is the life that was revealed we have seen it and testified to it and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us
verses.literalPt: (pois a vida se manifestou, e nós a temos visto, e testificamos dela, e vos anunciamos esta vida eterna, que estava com o Pai e a nós se manifestou),

verses.original: ὃ ἑωράκαμεν καὶ ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπαγγέλλομεν καὶ ὑμῖν ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς κοινωνίαν ἔχητε μεθ’ ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ κοινωνία δὲ ἡ ἡμετέρα μετὰ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ μετὰ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho heōrakamen kai akēkoamen apangellomen kai hymin hina kai hymeis koinōnian echēte meth’ hēmōn kai hē koinōnia de hē hēmetera meta tou Patros kai meta tou Huiou autou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard so that you also may have fellowship with us And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: o que temos visto e ouvido também vo-lo anunciamos, para que vós também tenhais comunhão conosco. A nossa comunhão é com o Pai e com seu Filho, Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτα γράφομεν ἡμεῖς ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη
verses.transliteration: kai tauta graphomen hēmeis hina hē chara hēmōn ē peplērōmenē
verses.literal: We write these things so that our joy may be complete
verses.literalPt: Essas coisas vos escrevemos, para que o nosso gozo seja completo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἔστιν αὕτη ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν καὶ σκοτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδεμία
verses.transliteration: Kai estin hautē hē angelia hēn akēkoamen ap’ autou kai anangellomen hymin hoti ho Theos phōs estin kai skotia en autō ouk estin oudemia
verses.literal: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you - God is light and in Him there is no darkness at all
verses.literalPt: A mensagem que dele temos ouvido e vos anunciamos é esta, que Deus é luz, e não há nele nenhumas trevas.

verses.original: Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ σκότει περιπατῶμεν ψευδόμεθα καὶ οὐ ποιοῦμεν τὴν ἀλήθειαν
verses.transliteration: Ean eipōmen hoti koinōnian echomen met’ autou kai en tō skotei peripatōmen pseudometha kai ou poioumen tēn alētheian
verses.literal: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness we lie and do not practice the truth
verses.literalPt: Se dissermos que temos comunhão com ele e andarmos nas trevas, mentimos e não praticamos a verdade.

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ περιπατῶμεν ὡς αὐτός ἐστιν ἐν τῷ φωτί κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετ’ ἀλλήλων καὶ τὸ αἷμα Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καθαρίζει ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: ean de en tō phōti peripatōmen hōs autos estin en tō phōti koinōnian echomen met’ allēlōn kai to haima Iēsou tou Huiou autou katharizei hēmas apo pasēs hamartias
verses.literal: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light we have fellowship with one another and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin
verses.literalPt: Se, porém, andarmos na luz, como ele está na luz, temos comunhão uns com os outros, e o sangue de Jesus, seu Filho, nos purifica de todo pecado.

verses.original: Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ἔχομεν ἑαυτοὺς πλανῶμεν καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Ean eipōmen hoti hamartian ouk echomen heautous planōmen kai hē alētheia ouk estin en hēmin
verses.literal: If we say we have no sin we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us
verses.literalPt: Se dissermos que não cometemos pecado, a nós mesmos nos enganamos, e a verdade não está em nós.

verses.original: ἐὰν ὁμολογῶμεν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν πιστός ἐστιν καὶ δίκαιος ἵνα ἀφῇ ἡμῖν τὰς ἁμαρτίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀδικίας
verses.transliteration: ean homologōmen tas hamartias hēmōn pistos estin kai dikaios hina aphē hēmin tas hamartias kai katharisē hēmas apo pasēs adikias
verses.literal: If we confess our sins He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness
verses.literalPt: Se confessarmos os nossos pecados, ele é fiel e justo para nos perdoar os pecados e para nos purificar de toda injustiça.

verses.original: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι οὐχ ἡμαρτήκαμεν ψεύστην ποιοῦμεν αὐτὸν καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: ean eipōmen hoti ouch hēmartēkamen pseustēn poioumen auton kai ho logos autou ouk estin en hēmin
verses.literal: If we say we have not sinned we make Him out to be . . . a liar and His word is not in us
verses.literalPt: Se dissermos que não temos cometido pecado, fazemo-lo mentiroso, e a sua palavra não está em nós.
